sources.prompt: Slice PAPER: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03215 -- title, authors, date, the mechanism in one paragraph, headline numbers, code + licence, what hardware it needs, and what it enables for (1) massive parallel decoding, (2) a messaging layer between agents, (3) storing graph nodes as KV caches for direct ingestion in compressed form (owner framing). Then follow its top-3 cited KV-cache compression works. READ-ONLY public pages, curl -sL (arxiv abs + /html/<id> or /pdf/<id> via pdftotext), no key, no install. Every claim URL + date, MEASURED (quoted) or ESTIMATE. WALL: hard 600 s -- budget 8 min: >= 6 pages, digest <= 100 lines APPENDED to /home/ubuntu/work/agi/.agi/context/local-maxxing/troves/2026-09-18-kv-nodes/<key>.md after every page, structured return by minute 8. Boxes: A1 4-core 23 GB no GPU; local-town 16 threads + gpu-8g; llama.cpp is the serving stack (it has --slot-save-path KV save/restore, prefix caching, -np parallel slots, KV cache type flags -ctk/-ctv).

Slice KV-CACHE COMPRESSION LANDSCAPE: TurboQuant (Google, 2025), KIVI, KVQuant, any work named like 'KV turbo' / 'KVTurbo' / 'TurboKV' (find what the owner likely means), plus the practical mechanisms already in llama.cpp: -ctk/-ctv quantised KV (q4_0/q8_0), --slot-save-path save/restore of a slot KV to disk, prompt/prefix caching across -np slots; for each: bits per KV element, measured quality loss, speed, code + licence, and the bytes for a 4k-token and a 32k-token cache on a 9B and a 27B model (ESTIMATE from head dims, show the arithmetic). Boxes: A1 4-core 23 GB no GPU; local-town 16 threads + gpu-8g; llama.cpp is the serving stack (it has --slot-save-path KV save/restore, prefix caching, -np parallel slots, KV cache type flags -ctk/-ctv).

angles.text: Owner paradigm: nodes stored AS KV caches -- a graph node (or a card, or a digest) is prefilled once, its compressed KV saved to disk beside the markdown, and any agent on the same model loads the KV instead of re-prefilling; chains must name the mechanism (llama.cpp slot save/restore + quantised KV; the paper technique), the bytes per node at 4-bit KV vs the markdown bytes, the model-pinning constraint (a KV is valid only for the exact model + context layout), the first $0 measurement on local-town (prefill time saved and bytes for 20 real nodes), and the failure mode when the model rotates.

A messaging layer where a message between agents is a KV delta (the sender ships the compressed KV of its message, the receiver appends it without prefill): chains name the exact bytes vs text, the shared-model requirement, what breaks with different models/harnesses (pi vs claude-code), and a $0 test on one local-town endpoint with two -np slots.

Massive parallelisation from shared compressed prefixes: one prefilled graph context shared by N decoding slots (-np 8+) with speculative decoding on top (hypothesis:lm-spec-decode-cpu-draft-hybrid); chains name aggregate tok/s bars, VRAM arithmetic inside 8 GB for the 5.95 GB Bonsai 2 27B, and the first measurement.
